claims.claim: B has work that A has been observing lately
claims.attribute: B has work (employment or task output) that A has been monitoring in the recent period
claims.adjudication_reason: Definite possessive 'your work lately' presupposes B has work and that A has had awareness of it over a recent period. 'Lately' implies temporal scope of observation. Reasonable E2 presupposition.

claims.claim: B has some kind of work or job
claims.adjudication_reason: 'Your work' presupposes B has some form of work. This is a weaker projection than c1 but not equivalent (c1 adds A's recent observation). Valid standalone E2 presupposition. Note: 'or job' slightly over-specifies but core claim holds.

claims.claim: A is disappointed with B's work lately
claims.attribute: B's recent work quality has disappointed A

evidence.quote: I am disappointed with your work lately

claims.adjudication_reason: Directly stated by A: 'I am disappointed with your work lately.' This is an explicit assertion about A's emotional state regarding B's work. E1 evidence.
